strings.en: Dancing with Death by Snargle Goldclaw

Venture to a long-shuttered corner of the world and untangle the mysteries of Cantha, a metropolitan nation of innovation fueled by powerful jade technologies.
(Requires the End of Dragons expansion.)

They've pushed the naga all the way out to the bay, though that fight is long from finished. I don't know what "Minister" Jimin expected, pushing them from their homes so we could build ours. After everything that we've experienced, you'd think there'd be a trickle of empathy left in his heart.

Emperor Bitgaram's health is weakening. The stress from the disaster—coupled with his advanced age—has made unifying Cantha even more challenging. He has left New Kaineng and is resting in the royal family's estate in Shing Jea. Haebaragi is leading our efforts here in his stead. Her vision is much aligned with mine, pushing Jimin to ease up on the naga as they flee to the west.

She wants to rebuild the Kaineng docks here—turn it into a new hub of trade for the nation. I've even heard whispers of reopening the borders, but that idea is still widely contested by the Ministry of Purity. Though, even they are falling out of fashion these days.

Minister Doh Taelin, Ministry of Archives, 1737 CC

I've stumbled upon the most bewitching alcove in the forest, tucked between roaring, aqueous falls and trees that pierce the heavens! And my hosts, they... Oh my, what souls they are.  
  
A village of kodan, hidden just beyond the gaze of Divinity's Reach! It's quite a small village, although size means nothing when the heart is true...  
  
My hosts seemed quite quizzical about my presence at first, but their leader, Stoic Alder ("stoic" **indeed**), assured me that I was more than welcome to rest in their den. And rest I have. The views are seductive. Their hot springs melt away the soreness of muscles, leaving one numb but weightless... The sense of danger is just enough to make my walks between homesteads at night titillating.   
  
The embrace of the rugged wilderness is what my soul desired, and I embraced it right back.  
  
—Snargle Goldclaw

As a part of our update to add gathering tool skins to the account wardrobe, gathering tools can now also be equipped with glyphs. Glyphs are a new type of upgrade that give your gathering tools additional beneficial properties when gathering, and they can be freely moved between tools without using an upgrade extractor. Gathering tools that already have bonus properties can be traded for new versions that convert their bonuses to glyphs at the Black Lion Exchange Specialist located in the Trader's Forum in Lion's Arch.

For more details about these changes, visit guildwars2.com. As always, thank you for your continued support!
